Rob Euerle

City Council Title: Ward 9 Phone: 216-418-8342 Email Rob Euerle

Physical Address

7163 Thorncliffe Boulevard Parma, Ohio 44134

Finance, Planning (Chairman), Public Safety, Public Housing, Appointment Scanning (Vice Chairman).

Ward 9 Councilman Rob Euerle began his first term in 2022 and is now proudly serving his second term, representing the residents of Ward 9 and the entire City of Parma.  A lifelong resident of Parma and a graduate of Parma Senior High School, Rob is deeply committed to making his community the best it can be.

After high school, Rob earned a degree in International Business from the University of Akron while simultaneously earning a Small Business Management degree from Cuyahoga Community College.

Rob volunteers approximately 300 hours each year with the Ohio State Highway Patrol as an Auxiliary Major, serving in a variety of capacities to help keep the community safe.  He is also an active member of several local and state organizations that support the Parma community, including the Parma Area Chamber of Commerce, as a current Board Member.

As the owner of multiple Parma-based businesses - many of which support veterans and youth throughout Greater Northeast Ohio - Rob has created hundreds of jobs over the years and generated over $1 million in total tax revenue to help improve the community. His businesses have attracted more than 250,000 visitors to Parma, benefiting local commerce and strengthening the city's economy.

Rob lives in Ward 9 with his wife, Dr. Leah Euerle, and their three daughters - Reagan, Harper, and Madison.  The Euerle's are also excited to welcome a fourth child in November 2025.
